problem: Truthy non-string POST replies bypass the existing success check. Object replies crash React; numeric/boolean replies wrongly acknowledge a send and clear the question draft.
fix: Add a string type condition to the existing nonempty POST reply check. Object/number/boolean replies now enter the existing uncertain-send error/review state while preserving the draft.

Previous history-row, send ownership/uncertain reconciliation/resend/IME and other completed suites not rerun; no full hosted route or physical device claim.

Only the POST reply fields used for acknowledgement and rendering are checked. Existing history predicate, server/DB data, request ownership, review/reconciliation/resend callbacks and IME behavior are unchanged. No manual review/resend is triggered in this suite.
